config._doc: Full local campaign (TASK.md 'bench/configs/full.yaml'): standard.json plus 1e8 records (does not fit any cache, ~1/3 of a 16 GB machine's RAM in legacy form), the rank sweep at 1e7 and the memory-budget experiment. About 8-9 h on the i9-9900K (measured simulation speed ~0.35-0.5 s per 1e6 records); run.py --budget-hours stops cleanly.

base.description: Unmodified upstream spcl/LogGOPSim: the last upstream commit before this project (merge of PR #18)

lazy.description: --lazy-decoding (ready nodes as indices, dependency counters in memory, trace never written); includes omp-first-pass

master.description: Self-describing format v2, unified TraceReader, plan runners plan/jit/orc/templated_node/templated_schema

master-plain.description: master without phase-timing hooks: checks that the instrumentation changes nothing

omp.description: Parallel (OpenMP) txt2bin first pass, legacy writer with pwrite

convert_tools._doc: txt2bin variants for the conversion experiment: build, output format, --threads (omp/lazy only; 0 = OMP_NUM_THREADS or all cores).

experiments._doc: 1e8 records (beyond every cache): two orders and two processes, since one process takes ~2 min here.
experiments.name: decode_micro_large

experiments._doc: 1e7 only: at 1e8 one conversion takes 2-5 min, and 13 tools x repetitions would need ~5 h.
experiments.name: convert

experiments._doc: Runs under a cgroup memory limit (systemd-run --user --scope, swap off) smaller than the trace's dirty-page demand: which configurations still finish, and how fast. Skipped if user cgroups are unavailable.
experiments.name: memory_budget

config.name: full

flags_check.note: Only -std may differ: upstream's CMakeLists sets CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11, NEW requires 23.
